epics.title: Stream Synchronization & Upstream Tracking
epics.description: Continuous monitoring and automated synchronization of upstream kernel releases (bleeding 7.3-rc2, mainstream 7.2.4, lts 6.18.50, and realtime 7.2-rt) in versions.json.

epics.title: KConfig Hardening & Minimal Attack Surface
epics.description: Kernel Self Protection Project (KSPP) compliance, modular security configuration fragments, and sysctl hardening for containerized orchestration.

epics.title: Multi-Architecture Cross Compilation
epics.description: Multi-architecture compilation matrix and cross-toolchain verification across x86_64, arm64, and riscv64 architectures.

epics.title: Dual Packaging & Unified Kernel Images (UKI)
epics.description: Dual package delivery supporting traditional Debian packages (.deb) and UEFI Unified Kernel Images (UKI) with systemd-stub and embedded initramfs for secure boot.

epics.title: Supply Chain Attestation & Cryptographic Signing
epics.description: Cryptographic keyless artifact signing via Sigstore Cosign, Syft CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM generation, and SLSA Build Level 3 provenance attestation.

epics.title: Hardware Acceleration & Driver Integration
epics.description: Hardware enablement fragments and out-of-tree patchsets for NVIDIA Blackwell/Hopper, Intel Xe2 Battlemage, AMD ROCm, OpenZFS 2.3, and sched-ext extensible scheduling.
